name: csv-auditor
description: A user's real Copilot session building a Docker-sandboxed CSV auditor on Cayu, replayed turn by turn. Answers the user gave to the agent's mid-turn questions are appended to the turn that asked them; ~/Desktop and the Cayu GitHub link are replaced by the replay directory and the checkout under test. Greetings, mode switches, and an off-topic question are omitted. The user's 'start it' / 'done' device-login turns need a person at a browser; a note on 'run it' says sign-in was completed, so 'run it' keeps its original meaning.
turns:
Can you create a new agent in {WORKDIR} using cayu?

(If you need to ask: the agent uses a docker sandbox to parse large CSVs and report issues. For cayu, use the Cayu source at {CAYU_SOURCE}; its `cayu` CLI is already on PATH.)
create a md file named LEARNINGS and document your journey with Cayu, and keep documenting any issues you see with it there.
document your mistakes too, like why you expected something to be there and it wasn't. tooling blockers as well
Why don't you just use the latest Cayu code from {CAYU_SOURCE}?
make it possible to sign in with openai subscription using device mode

(I started the device sign-in you set up and completed it in my browser.)

run it

Now make it a proper web app

(If you need to ask: it's a local-only app for me. Workflow: upload CSVs, run audits, view and download reports.)
give me a test file i can use
so it finds stuff for review, then what?
